fields.Institution: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management
fields.Approval / Accreditation: Institute of National Importance; UGC; AICTE where applicable
fields.Intake — Published:
30 regular MBA seats in 2026–27 prospectus, plus 3 foreign supernumerary Study in India seats. Old programme-page 25 is superseded.
Published numeric intake: 30
fields.Fees — Published: 2026–27 first-semester gross ₹2,05,450 (General/OBC/EWS), including ₹15,000 refundable security and hostel rent; tuition ₹1,27,500/semester. Mess ₹27,000/semester extra.
fields.Fee Scope: ₹5.10 L remains conditional four-semester tuition only, not full attendance cost. Category waivers apply.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT / MAT / CMAT / NIFTEM entrance under 2026 prospectus; programme page gives older CAT/MAT route.
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with 50% aggregate (45% SC/ST), official programme page.
fields.Selection Process: CAT/MAT or internal test followed by GD/PI, academics and work experience; consult 2026 prospectus for CMAT route and current weights.
fields.Median CTC — Published: ₹6.25 L is 2023–24 pooled PG two-year median, including non-MBA courses; MBA-only median not validated.
fields.Highest CTC — Published:
₹16 lakh MBA maximum in the institute’s official 2025 placement update, offered by Adani Wilmar. This is the reported maximum as of the July–September 2025 newsletter, not an inferred individual-profile statistic.
Reported highest ₹L: 16
fields.Placement — Published: 55 placed out of 80 PG graduates; 22 selected for higher studies (official NIRF 2025)
fields.Placement Scope: Highest is MBA-specific, 2025; median ₹6.25 L pools all PG two-year programmes, 2023-24.
fields.Top Recruiters: Adani Wilmar (MBA highest, 2025); PepsiCo, AB InBev, ITC, HealthKart, Anveshan, Coldex and Blue Tokai (pooled B.Tech/M.Tech/MBA recruiters)
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Brand Manager; Sales/Business Development; Digital Marketing; Market Research; Export/Trade
fields.Notes: Recovered MBA capacity 25 and MBA 2025 highest ₹16 L from official programme page/newsletter. MBA mean is not published. Median ₹6.25 L describes all PG two-year programmes. Replaced legacy fee ₹6 L with transparent conditional tuition basis ₹5.10 L; full attendance cost is higher.
fields.Fee Evidence: Official 2026–27 first-semester schedule p 57; complete future semester invoices not guaranteed.
fields.Current Audit Note: 18 Oct 2026 public-source review. Checked: 2026 MBA30 regular+3 foreign; 50% degree/45%SCST; CAT/MAT/CMAT/internal test,GDPI; 2026 first-semester components, Official 2025 newsletter explicitly identifies MBA maximum ₹16 lakh at Adani Wilmar; checked downloaded text, not inferred from a profile.. Retain MBA2025₹16 L highest from separately sourced official newsletter; clear pooled PG2₹6.25 L from actual MBA median.
